g.text: Paired change versus 2 µs baseline; probe shots and acquisition time stay fixed. Bars are unadjusted 95% bootstrap intervals. * marks global Holm p < 0.05 across latency tests. Negative residual changes favor PQEC; reference point is zero by definition.
